headlines.title: Charles Schwab Integrating AI Tools and Financial Planning
headlines.summary: Charles Schwab is expanding its push into artificial intelligence, bringing Anthropic's Claude for Financial Advisors directly into Schwab Advisor Center. The company says it is the first RIA custodian to offer Anthropic's advisor-specific AI to independent firms. Alison Dooher, Head of AI at Schwab Advisor Services, joins Bloomberg Businessweek Live from Schwab IMPACT Summit in Boston to discuss how AI is changing the financial advice landscape.

headlines.title: Schwab Offers Credit to RIAs to Prompt Use of Claude AI Enterprise Plan
headlines.summary: Schwab’s AI lead said RIAs would receive a $4,800 credit if they sign up for the enterprise version of Claude for Financial Advisors, initially eliminating a cost restriction for smaller firms.

headlines.title: Schwab Reaffirms Commitment to Smaller Advisory Firms
headlines.summary: The CEO of the leading investment advisor custodian says it is committed to supporting firms of all sizes. He also said Schwab isn’t competing with its independent partners.

headlines.title: Schwab CEO Wurster Commits to Small RIAs
headlines.summary: CEO Rick Wurster kicked off the firm’s annual Impact conference in Boston with a pledge to continue supporting the firm’s 11,000 RIA clients with under $100 million in assets, just after competitor Fidelity announced it would drop firms of similar size.

headlines.title: Schwab Advisor Services™ Expands AI Inside Schwab Advisor Center and Across the Third-Party Solutions RIAs Use
headlines.summary: WESTLAKE, Texas & BOSTON, October 28, 2026--Schwab Advisor Services, Charles Schwab's business supporting the growth and success of more than 17,000 independent registered investment advisors (RIAs), today announced new AI solutions for RIAs, available inside Schwab Advisor Center and through the third-party solutions that connect to it. The news was announced from Schwab IMPACT®, the largest and longest running annual event for RIAs and the ecosystem that serves them.

description: The Charles Schwab Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a savings and loan holding company that provides wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody, and financial advisory services in the United States and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Investor Services and Advisor Services. It offers brokerage accounts with equity and fixed income trading, margin lending, options trading, futures and forex trading, and cash management capabilities, including money market funds, and certificates of deposit; third-party mutual funds through the Mutual Fund Marketplace and Mutual Fund OneSource service, as well as mutual fund trading and clearing services to broker-dealers; exchange-traded funds; advisory solutions for managed portfolios, separately managed accounts, customized personal advice for tailored portfolios, specialized planning, and full-time portfolio management; banking products comprising checking and savings accounts, first lien residential real estate mortgage loans, home equity lines of credit, and pledged asset lines; and trust custody services, personal trust reporting services, and administrative trustee services. It provides digital and software based trading platforms; research tools, and multichannel support, real-time market data, options trading; equity compensation plan sponsors full-service recordkeeping for stock plans, stock options, restricted stock, performance shares, and stock appreciation rights; retirement plan services; mutual fund clearing services; and advisor services, including interactive tools and educational content. The Company operates through branch offices. The Charles Schwab Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Westlake, Texas.
